reader.help1: Swipe the page to turn it, or use the page slider.
reader.help2: Tap any ayah to listen to it and read its tafsir.
reader.help3: “Listen with tafsir” splits the screen in two: the ayah being recited, and its short tafsir below it.
reader.waiting: Press play to start the recitation with tafsir.
reader.khatmaNone: No khatma yet. Start one and your progress is counted from the last page you read.
reader.khatmaDone: Khatma complete. May Allah accept it from you.
reader.khatmaStart: Start a new khatma from al-Fatihah
reader.fullHint: To turn pages, swipe the page or press the arrows at the sides. To show the tools, press “Show tools”.
reader.guide1: Tap any ayah to show its options under the page: listen, ayah tafsir, bookmark, copy, share.
reader.guide2: To turn pages: swipe the page, or use the page slider under it.
reader.guide3: “Full screen” at the top hides the tools; “Show tools” brings them back.
reader.guide4: “Listen with tafsir” shows the page and its tafsir side by side while it is recited.
